post.instagram_caption:
About $2 trillion wiped off tech stocks in October.

According to Reuters, the Nasdaq 100 lost about $2 trillion in value this month as Big Tech reported results. Intel had its worst day since 1974. Alphabet and Amazon fell after raising their spending plans.

The real issue: tech giants are spending around $750 billion on AI this year, and investors now want proof it pays off. But it isn't a crash: the index is about 10% off its peak.

Source: Reuters, Oct 30, 2026.

About $2 trillion in market value was wiped off the Nasdaq 100 in October, as Big Tech's results made investors question whether huge AI spending will pay off. Intel had its worst day since 1974, and Alphabet and Amazon fell after raising their spending plans. But the index is about 10% off its peak, closer to a correction than a crash.
